sections.title: Casino Gaming Analytics
sections.description: For MGM Resorts, Caesars Entertainment, Wynn Resorts, and Las Vegas's NGCB-regulated casino industry.

blocks.heading: Player lifecycle analytics
paragraphs: ML for the casino's most valuable operational insight — understanding individual player behavior, predicting player churn, and identifying the players who are most likely to respond to re-activation campaigns. Casino player data is unusually rich: every bet, drink order, hotel stay, restaurant visit, and entertainment purchase is attributed to a single player account, creating a longitudinal behavioral dataset that most industries can only dream of.

blocks.heading: NGCB-compliant responsible gaming AI
paragraphs: Nevada Gaming Control Board regulations require licensed casinos to offer responsible gaming programs — ML for identifying players showing signs of problem gambling behavior (session length patterns, loss-chasing sequences, unusual bet size escalation) for the responsible gaming intervention programs that NGCB oversight requires.

blocks.heading: Casino fraud and advantage play detection
paragraphs: ML for detecting card counting, shuffle tracking, hole-card play, and the sophisticated advantage play techniques that professional gamblers use — and distinguishing advantage play from normal statistical variance in a high-volume gaming environment.

sections.title: Hospitality Revenue Management
sections.description: MGM's and Caesars's enormous hotel-convention operations.

blocks.heading: Las Vegas hotel demand forecasting
paragraphs: ML for the uniquely variable demand patterns of Las Vegas hotels — the combination of conventions (CES, NAB, MJBiz), boxing and UFC events, residency shows (Adele, Celine Dion's successors), the Super Bowl rotation, and leisure travel creates demand volatility that generic hotel revenue management systems under-model.

blocks.heading: Convention and meeting demand analytics
paragraphs: ML for the Las Vegas Convention Center and Sands Expo's meeting planner analytics — predicting which meeting planner inquiries will convert, optimizing proposal pricing, and forecasting ancillary revenue from food and beverage, A/V, and exhibit services.

sections.title: Sports Betting Analytics
sections.description: Nevada pioneered legal sports betting and remains the largest state sports betting market by handle per capita.

blocks.heading: Sports betting risk management
paragraphs: ML for Nevada's licensed sports books — predicting the outcome of sporting events to inform line-setting, detecting sharp money movement that indicates sophisticated bettor activity, and managing the exposure on large bets that require immediate line adjustment.

blocks.heading: Player risk segmentation for sportsbooks
paragraphs: ML for distinguishing casual recreational bettors from professional sports bettors for the sportsbook operators managing their long-term player economics.

sections.title: Healthcare
sections.description: Dignity Health's St. Rose Dominican Hospitals, Valley Health System, and University Medical Center of Southern Nevada.

blocks.heading: Clark County trauma and emergency analytics
paragraphs: ML for the high-acuity trauma cases and emergency medicine at UMC — Las Vegas's visitor population creates emergency medicine case mix characteristics that are distinct from resident-only health systems.

blocks.heading: Nevada Medicaid analytics
paragraphs: Population health ML for the managed care organizations serving Nevada's Medicaid program in the Las Vegas market.
